First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Morning Nomad Leisurely Ride group ride

Saturday Morning Nomad Leisurely Ride is a road and social group ride in Tulsa, OK. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Varies weekly (recent: Sapulpa, Sand Springs); see the club calendar.

A slow Saturday ride that moves around Tulsa each week, hence the name. Ten to 12 mph, nobody left behind. The club also runs a faster Saturday club ride that is not no-drop.
